questions.solution:
def is_happy(n):
    seen = set()
    while n != 1 and n not in seen:
        seen.add(n)
        n = sum(int(d) ** 2 for d in str(n))
    return n == 1

print('Happy:', is_happy(19))

questions.description: 函数返回出现次数最多字符。
函数返回列表合并去重。
函数返回数字进制形式。
函数返回元组解包结果。
函数返回列表平均值与中位数。
questions.code_template:
def stats(nums):
    avg = sum(nums) / len(nums)
    sorted_nums = sorted(nums)
    mid = len(sorted_nums) // 2
    median = sorted_nums[mid]
    return avg, median

a, m = stats([3, 1, 2])
print(___, m)
questions.solution:
def stats(nums):
    avg = sum(nums) / len(nums)
    sorted_nums = sorted(nums)
    mid = len(sorted_nums) // 2
    median = sorted_nums[mid]
    return avg, median

a, m = stats([3, 1, 2])
print(round(a, 1), m)

questions.description: 函数返回字符串中数字和。
函数返回去重排序单词。

questions.code_template:
def max_gain(prices):
    min_price = prices[0]
    max_profit = 0
    for p in prices:
        min_price = min(min_price, p)
        max_profit = max(max_profit, p - min_price)
    return max_profit

print('Gain:',___)
questions.solution:
def max_gain(prices):
    min_price = prices[0]
    max_profit = 0
    for p in prices:
        min_price = min(min_price, p)
        max_profit = max(max_profit, p - min_price)
    return max_profit

print('Gain:', max_gain([7, 1, 5, 3, 6, 4]))
